name: Agonizing Blast
description: Add your Charisma modifier to the damage of your Warlock damage cantrip (Eldritch Blast if you know it).

name: Armor of Shadows
description: Mage Armor at will: without armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

name: Eldritch Mind
description: Advantage on Constitution saves to keep concentrating on a spell.

name: Eldritch Spear
description: Your Warlock damage cantrip's range grows by 30 ft per Warlock level.

name: Pact of the Blade
description: Bond with your first melee weapon: you're proficient with it and can use Charisma for its attack and damage rolls.

name: Repelling Blast
description: When your Warlock damage cantrip hits a Large or smaller creature, push it 10 ft straight away from you.

name: Devil's Sight
description: See normally in darkness, magical or not, within 120 ft. (Story and exploration; battles don't model darkness yet.)
